LanguageData.HE_Start_Albion.label: Heirs of Albion
LanguageData.HE_Start_Albion.description: Five chartered settlers of Albion claim a new land for the commonwealth. They start with the Albion heritage, a flintlock musket, a sabre, steel, components and the parliamentary papers.
